concerns.text: Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates the project directory layout and writes `__init__.py` files. Running this in parallel with any downstream task that expects those directories/files can cause race conditions. The task should not be marked `[P]`.

Task T012 assembles `results/analysis_results.json` and expects “phrasing‑check flags” to be present, but no prior task produces such flags. This creates a missing producer dependency; a task that generates the phrasing‑check flags must be added before T012 or the requirement removed.
